title: Multi-Engine 23-Job Reconciliation & Revalidation Gap Census
purpose: derive an exact, conservative job-by-job revalidation status from the immutable R4.2 registry and all locally preserved R4 evidence
closure_rule: only explicit R4.50 Geonomics full-job closure is promoted automatically in R4.51
prior_evidence_rule: prior non-Geonomics scientific-looking evidence may become an R4.52 promotion candidate but cannot close a job in R4.51
important_distinctions: process returncode zero is not scientific revalidation
runtime READY is not scientific revalidation
preflight or mapping authority is not scientific revalidation
failed evidence remains preserved and visible
valid scientific evidence candidates are adjudicated before deciding to rerun
nonclaim: R4.51 performs a census only; it neither promotes historical non-Geonomics evidence nor executes an engine
